question: In which of the following Indian States was the 50th All India Inter-Institutional Table Tennis Championships organised in 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Andhra Pradesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **50th All India Inter-Institutional Table Tennis Championships** was organized in **2023** in the state of **Andhra Pradesh**.
 
• This event is a significant milestone in the Indian table tennis calendar, bringing together top players from various institutions across the country.
 
• The championships are aimed at promoting table tennis and encouraging competitive spirit among players.
 
• Andhra Pradesh has been actively promoting sports and has the infrastructure to host national-level events.
 
• The event saw participation from numerous institutions, making it a highly competitive and prestigious tournament.
